note: Maps every dlp_* rule in DLP_PATTERNS to the generators whose values it must find. Each probe is a minimal carrier; the rule alone must report exactly the <<secret:0>> span. shape_only generators predate E03 and are format-shaped without a valid checksum or structure; they stay for the E02 goldens. weak generators are real values the rule must keep reporting: low-variety values outside example context (T06: repeated chunk, sequential run) and placeholder-like shapes (T07: SCREAMING_SNAKE without a placeholder word, leading $ with digits); carriers do not use them. quoted generators (F-GEN2) are real values with spaces or ;/,/} inside that the rule reports up to the closing quote; each probe wraps them in double quotes, and carriers do not use them. url_encoded generators (T17) are real values with RFC 3986 reserved characters (@ $ :) that the rule reports percent-encoded with the encoded span; each probe inserts them as <<secret:0|url>>, and carriers do not use them. lookalike generators (F03, F04, F05, F-LLM) are values in the rule's shape with a wrong check value or length that the rule must not report; goldens use them as hard negatives in carriers without key context. Content rules have no secret value and are covered by carrier templates (E04). baseline_entities (GOLD-D2) are entity_map entities without an ARK rule (scope baseline_only): their generators follow the format of the baseline rule or vendor documentation (field source) and only feed carrier gold, so ARK and every baseline get a number before ARK has a rule; their lookalike generators (wrong prefix, length or character set) are carrier hard negatives. When ARK gains a rule for one, the entry moves to rules.
